₹50 lakh home loan for 20 years: can you guess the interest?

Illustrative at 8.5% a year (within the range lenders list in 2026 rate round-ups): EMI ≈ ₹43,391 for 240 months.
Total paid back ≈ ₹1.04 crore, so interest ≈ ₹54 lakh, more than the loan itself.
At an illustrative 8% instead, interest is ≈ ₹50.4 lakh: half a percent is worth about ₹3.8 lakh.
Ask the lender for the total interest, not just the EMI.
